design_description: A heritage-driven design inspired by Terrassa's Masia Freixa, using a deep teal base paired with warm cream and Catalan red-and-yellow accents. A detailed architectural silhouette of the Masia Freixa wraps around the lower hem, turning a local landmark into the defining visual element of the kit. Curved senyera-inspired side panels add movement and regional identity while framing the central teal body. Cream collar, cuffs, crest details, and typography soften the palette, while a small Catalan flag below the back collar completes the local references. Overall, the jersey feels distinctive, elegant, and deeply connected to Terrassa, translating the city's architecture and Catalan identity into a modern football design.
